literal: As you eat, so you shall receive.
meaning: As you sow, so shall you reap. Actions determine the results.
hindi: जैसा कर्म करोगे, वैसा ही फल पाओगे।

literal: The wild berries ripened, but I could not taste them.
meaning: Deep folk metaphor for missed opportunities, longing, or unfulfilled desires in the mountains.
hindi: अवसर हाथ से निकल जाने या विरह की कसक।

pakhana: डांड्यूं का डाळ, पानी का पाळ।
literal: Mountains have trees, rivers have embankments.
meaning: Nature has provided natural protection and order for everything in life.
hindi: प्रकृति में प्रत्येक वस्तु का अपना रक्षक और संतुलन होता है।

pakhana: आपु मरे बिना सरग नी देखिंद।
literal: Without dying oneself, one cannot see heaven.
meaning: True realization or success comes only through direct personal effort.
hindi: स्वयं मेहनत किए बिना सफलता या प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव नहीं मिलता।

pakhana: घौर कु जोगी जोगणा, आन गौं कु सिद्ध।
literal: A monk of one's own house is dismissed as a beggar, but an outsider monk is revered as a sage.
meaning: Familiarity breeds contempt; people overlook wisdom at home while praising outsiders.
hindi: घर की प्रतिभा की कद्र न होना, बाहरी व्यक्ति को अधिक सम्मान देना।

pakhana: जखि देखि तवा परात, बखि बिताई सारी रात।
literal: Wherever a frying pan and plate of food were spotted, there the whole night was spent.
meaning: An opportunist who settles wherever free comforts and food are available.
hindi: अवसरवादी व्यक्ति जो जहाँ सुविधा और भोजन मिले वहीं टिक जाता है।

literal: Walked for nine days, reached only two and a half kos.
meaning: Extremely slow, sluggish, and inefficient pace of work.
hindi: अत्यंत धीमी गति से कार्य होना।

literal: When you are enlightened/matured, the whole world becomes matured.
meaning: Reform begins with self-improvement; when you improve yourself, your view of the world improves.
hindi: पहले स्वयं में सुधार करो, फिर संसार अच्छा दिखेगा।

literal: Dig your own well, drink your own fresh water.
meaning: Self-reliance and hard independent labor yield the sweetest reward.
hindi: आत्मनिर्भर बनो, अपने परिश्रम से ही सच्ची तृप्ति मिलती है।

pakhana: छै गौकि छांछ, नंदू का खावन।
literal: Six villages produce buttermilk, yet poor Nandu suffers scarcity.
meaning: Abundance all around, yet the deserving or destitute person remains deprived.
hindi: चारों तरफ प्रचुरता होने पर भी किसी अभावग्रस्त को लाभ न मिलना।
